lesson.name: Learn the Semi-Slav Defense
lesson.description: Learn the essentials of the Semi-Slav Defense, including pawn structures, tactics and key themes to know.

{How should Black gain time to develop the c8 bishop by making threats?} 6...
dxc4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Trade pawns and
attack the d3 bishop.]} (6... Be7 $5 {This is playable, but there's a stronger
and more popular move. Try to find it.}) (6... a6 $5 {This is playable, but
there's a stronger and more popular move. Try to find it.}) (6... Bd6 $2 7. e4
{White takes over the initiative with a slight advantage. Try to find a
stronger move.}) 7. Bxc4 {Good start! How should you continue to attack
White's bishop?} b5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find it.] [%hint
Advance a pawn to attack the c4 bishop.]} (7... c5 $2 8. O-O {White is
slightly better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (7... Bb4 $2 8. O-O {White is
slightly better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (7... Nb6 $2 8. Bd3 {It's
difficult for Black to activate the c8 bishop. Try to find a stronger move.})
8. Bd3 {Well played! White's bishop has returned to the square it was on two
moves earlier. How can Black develop the c8 bishop?} Bb7 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Develop your c8 bishop to aim toward the
center.] Well played! You have reached one of the main lines of the Meran
Variation.} (8... a6 $5 {This is a good move, but we're looking to develop the
c8 bishop right away. How can you do that?}) (8... Bd6 $5 {This is a good move,
but we're looking to develop the c8 bishop right away. How can you do that?}) (
8... b4 $5 {This is a good move, but we're looking to develop the c8 bishop
right away. How can you do that?}) (8... Ba6 $2 {The bishop is shut in behind
a pinned pawn on a6. Try to find a better bishop move.}) *

{Black's played the poor Bd6, instead of capturing on c4. How should White
take over the center?} 7. e4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it
and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Advance a center pawn.]} (7. c5 $2
Bc7 {Black has a comfortable position. Try to find a better move.}) (7. O-O $5
{This is reasonable, but there's a better option. Try to find it.}) 7... dxe4 {
Nice move! How should you recapture?} 8. Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find it.] [%hint Recapture and centralize a knight.] Good move! White
has better central control and Black's position remains cramped.} (8. Bxe4 $5 {
This is OK, but there's no need to give up the bishop pair for White. Try to
find a stronger move.}) *

it?}) (5... h6 $5 {This is playable, but we're looking to capture a pawn. How
can you do it?}) (5... Nbd7 $5 {This is playable, but we're looking to capture
a pawn. How can you do it?}) 6. e4 {Good move! How can you hold onto your pawn?
} b5 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try to find it.] [%hint Defend c4.]

compensation.} (6... h6 $2 7. Bxf6 {White will capture on c4 next turn with a
good position. Try to find a stronger move.}) (6... Bb4 $2 7. Bxc4 {White has
good development and central control. Try again.}) 0-1
